tool.name: MaxQuant (using mqpar.xml)
tool.command:
export COMPlus_EnableDiagnostics=0 && ## link galaxy datasets to filenames accepted by maxquant #import re #set $link_names = [] #for $infile in $infiles #set $identifier = re.sub('@SUBSTITUTION_RX@', '_', str($infile.element_identifier)) #if $infile.is_of_type("brukertdf.d.tar") #set $link_name = re.sub('(?i)\\.tar$', '', $identifier) #if not $link_name.lower().endswith(".d") #set $link_name = $link_name + ".d" #end if #elif $identifier.lower().endswith("."+$infile.ext) #set $link_name = $identifier #else #set $link_name = $identifier + "." + $infile.ext #end if #if $infile.ext == 'thermo.raw': cp '$infile' '$link_name' && #elif $infile.is_of_type("brukertdf.d.tar") mkdir -p '$link_name' && tar -xf '$infile' -C '$link_name' --strip-components=1 && #else: ln -s '$infile' '$link_name' && #end if #silent $link_names.append($link_name) #end for
python3 '$__tool_directory__/modify_mqpar.py' --infiles #echo ' '.join([f"'{n}'" for n in $link_names]) --version @VERSION@ --num_threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --substitution_rx '@SUBSTITUTION_RX@' --fasta_files '$fasta_files' --description_parse_rule '$description_parse_rule' --identifier_parse_rule '$identifier_parse_rule' '$mqpar_input'
&& maxquant mqpar.xml #if 'log' in $output_opts.output: >> '$log' #end if && mv mqpar.xml combined/txt/mqpar.xml #if 'output_all' in $output: && tar -zcf '$output_all' ./combined/txt #end if

param.name: infiles
param.label: Infiles
param.help: One or more files. All need to be of the same datatype. Bruker .d folders must use the brukertdf.d.tar datatype and contain one top-level .d directory.

param.name: fasta_files
param.label: FASTA files
param.help: Specify one or more FASTA databases.

param.name: mqpar_input
param.label: mqpar.xml file with your search parameters
param.help: Use this as a MaxQuant parameter template. The wrapper ignores raw file entries in this mqpar.xml and writes the selected Galaxy infiles into the generated mqpar.xml before MaxQuant starts.

param.name: exp_design
param.label: Experimental design template
param.help: Optional MaxQuant experimental design table. The Name column is matched to the selected Galaxy infiles after filename sanitization. Matched Galaxy paths are written into the generated mqpar.xml.

tool.help:
MaxQuant is a quantitative proteomics software package designed for analyzing large mass-spectrometric data sets.
This tool is a wrapper for MaxQuant v@VERSION@. It gets its search parameters from a previously created parameter file (mqpar.xml). A similiar tool that allows the specification of search parameters directly through galaxy is available as well and should be preferred, if possible.
**Input files**
- Thermo raw, mzML, mzXML files, or Bruker .d folders tarred as `*.d.tar` - The datatype of all non-Bruker files has to be either 'thermo.raw', 'mzml' or 'mzxml'. Make sure to specify the correct datatype either during upload to Galaxy or afterwards (edit attributes --> datatypes) - Bruker .d folders must use the `brukertdf.d.tar` datatype and contain one top-level `.d` directory. The wrapper extracts the archive and passes the resulting `.d` directory to MaxQuant. - mqpar.xml: - MaxQuant parameters will be taken from the provided mqpar.xml file. This parameter file MUST be created using the same version of MaxQuant as is used by this tool. The correct version of MaxQuant can be obtained via the bioconda channel for the conda package manager.
**Output files**
Different output file options are available, most of them are part of the MaxQuant txt folder. An additional mztab output option is implemented.
